diagnosis: The third-party egress debugging route returns captured outgoing HTTP requests tracked via node:diagnostics_channel and AsyncLocalStorage. The endpoint relies solely on requestId to look up the log entry and omits checking whether entry.organizationId matches req.user.organizationId. Attackers can view outgoing payloads, third-party webhook headers, and external API tokens belonging to other organizations.
